name: Rejection requires a comment and terminates the request

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.reject@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'New Request' page (URL /requests/create), select 'Annual Leave', set Start date to 2026-11-10 and End date to 2026-11-10, enter reason 'E2E reject marker' and click 'Submit request'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button in the top-right corner.
Log in with email 'supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Supervisor Queue' page (URL /approvals/supervisor), find the row for employee 'Flow Reject' with reason 'E2E reject marker' and click its 'Reject' button.
In the reject dialog, click the 'Reject' submit button WITHOUT entering any comment text.
The rejection is blocked by a required-field validation message: the dialog does not close and the request remains pending.
Type 'Not approved - coverage conflict' into the rejection reason textarea and click the 'Reject' submit button in the dialog.
The request is no longer present in the supervisor queue.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.reject@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
The 'E2E reject marker' request shows the 'Rejected' status with the rejection comment 'Not approved - coverage conflict' visible.
